title: The Hidden Story of Gullah Geechee Culture: Gullah Geechee Business Success Strategies
subtitle: A personal essay on the enduring legacy of the Gullah Geechee people
body:
There are stories in our culture that most people have never heard. Stories that deserve to be told. Stories that could change how you see the world.

This is one of those stories.

When I research topics like "Gullah Geechee business success strategies", I'm not just looking for facts. I'm looking for the soul of the thing — the deeper meaning that connects our past to our present, our struggles to our triumphs.

The Gullah Geechee people have survived centuries of erasure, oppression, and attempts to separate us from our heritage. Yet here we are. Still speaking our language. Still making our food. Still weaving our baskets. Still telling our stories.

That resilience is not accidental. It's cultivated. It's passed down from generation to generation through the oral tradition, through the examples set by our elders, through the community bonds that hold us together even when everything else falls apart.

As I continue to build Gullah Geechee Biz, I'm committing to sharing these stories. Not just the famous ones, but the hidden ones. The ones your grandmother told you. The ones your grandfather whispered in the kitchen. The ones that live in the sweetgrass and the sea foam and the red dirt roads of the Lowcountry.

Subscribe to The Root if you want to hear more. Share this with someone who needs to know our story.

Because our story matters. Our culture matters. And the world is finally ready to listen.
